title: Rav Chanin son of Rav Yeiva
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A great man in Rava’s time, as in [Bava Batra 174a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.174a.11-12), where Rava said: “Who is wise enough to do such a thing, if not Rav Chanin son of Rav Yeiva?” (He removed the judge who had sent the creditor down into the borrower’s property before the creditor had made his claim against the borrower.)
Yuchasin cites Rav Chana bar Yeiva in Rav’s time. Hyman considers this correct, for his reading was that “Rav said: Who is wise enough to do,” etc., as cited in Yuchasin HaShalem.

notes.text: The linked Gemara gives Rava praising Rav Chanin son of Rav Yeiva. Hyman takes the judge to be the person removed. The Davidson English has Rav Chanin overrule the judge and remove the creditor from the property. His reading of Rav and Rav Chana bar Yeiva comes from the Yuchasin reading he reports.
